transcription.text: And they concluded that it is when context changes,
it's when a job changes or someone moves
or the family dynamics change,
that those stressors can really make one susceptible
to just seasons of being overwhelmed
or seasons of anxiousness.
And I know I'm not the only one who has wrestled with this.
Mason Curry is an author, and he wrote a book
about famous authors and composers and thinkers
and writers and artists.
And these were ones he wrote about
who wrestle with anxiousness, even with depression,
and they developed daily rituals
that would help them moderate their own feelings
but also allow them to do really productive work.
See, research has shown us that artists
are particularly susceptible to anxiety and depression.
Not every single artist, but artists as a whole,
compared to the entire population,
are a group of people that--
